title: Spatial response resampling (SR2) for hyperspectral image analysis
author: Inamdar, Kalacska, et al.

steps.title: Derive the 2D PSFnet
steps.instruction: Calculate the two-dimensional Point Spread Function network (PSFnet) based on sensor characteristics and flight parameters.

substeps.instruction: Derive the PSFopt, PSFmot, and PSFdet.
Generate the cross track PSFnet by convolving PSFopt and PSFdet.
Generate the along track PSFnet by convolving PSFopt, PSFmot, and PSFdet.

If adjacent cross track pixels are summed to boost signal (summing level s ≥ 2), modify the cross track PSFnet using the provided summation formula where rx is the nominal pixel resolution in the cross track direction (width of PSFdet) and x is the cross track displacement from the pixel center.
Derive the total 2D PSFnet by vector multiplication of the modified cross track and along track PSFnets.
Reparametrize the total PSFnet as a function of pixel displacement in the easting and northing directions via matrix rotation by the nominal flight line heading (° True North).

steps.title: Generate the Convolution Kernel
steps.instruction: Convert the total PSFnet into a normalized convolution kernel compatible with the input HSI data resolution.

substeps.instruction: Spatially degrade the total PSFnet to the same pixel size as the input HSI data by spatially integrating the PSFnet in intervals equal to the input HSI data pixel size.
Normalize the resulting output matrix (the convolution kernel) so that it sums to unity.

steps.title: Convolve HSI Data
steps.instruction: Apply the convolution kernel to the input HSI data to simulate the spatial characteristics of the target sensor.

substeps.instruction: Convolve the normalized kernel with the input HSI data to blur the imagery.
Ensure the pixel size of the input HSI data remains unchanged after this convolution step.

steps.title: Spatially Resample HSI Data
steps.instruction: Adjust the resolution of the blurred HSI data to match the simulated sensor's pixel size.

substeps.instruction: Spatially subset the blurred HSI data to the pixel size of the simulated sensor using a nearest neighbor resampling technique.
